ModMetaData.name: RimMT S5.3 Composite Optimizer
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: Experimental S5.3 composite WorkGiver optimizer for RimWorld 1.5. Includes BuildRoof candidate pruning, Tend map-state gating, GrowerHarvest pruning, ClearSnow pruning, GrowerSow candidate/index restructuring, and DoBill BillGiver indexing. Each feature is independent and fail-closed when incompatible Harmony authority patches are detected.
